+# Concentrating two paths on the original bipartition
+
+## Abstract
+
+Two actual B-ended paths concentrate on the complete original labelled bipartition with an exact six-vertex residual and a signed-Catalan shift.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (The actual graph move and its exact Catalan difference).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/TwoPathConcentration.actual_two_path_concentration`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/TwoPathConcentration.actual_two_path_concentration` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The finite carrier is arbitrary. Its original disjoint independent parts A and B cover every vertex. ActualTwoPaths gives a complete adjacency correspondence with paths of orders 2p+1 and 2q+1 and the given induced graph on R. It fixes every R label and gives one original B endpoint of each path. A compiled path-colouring argument derives that the original A vertices occupy odd positions and the B vertices occupy even positions from independence, disjointness, and coverage. Both p and q are at least one.
+
+The move isolates the last B vertex of the first path. Its remaining prefix has 2p vertices and is concatenated with the whole second path. The resulting path has 2p+2q+1 vertices. The new graph has the same full carrier and the same pointwise A and B labels. Its coordinates describe every edge, including the absence of edges between these path components and R; all R relations are unchanged.
+
+Independent configurations of a disjoint graph sum decompose into pairs of actual configurations by disjoint union. Their cardinalities add, and the empty configurations remain included. Exact graph relabeling then transports the entire configuration families to the given original labels. Weighted partition sums multiply along this decomposition, so the arbitrary graph R contributes exactly once.
+
+The residual keeps the first 2p-2 original vertices of the first path, the first 2q-2 original vertices of the second path, and every vertex of R. Its adjacency is the induced original adjacency. The embedding and the cardinality equation show that precisely six original vertices were removed; no residual vertices are added.
+
+For every m at least the full original cardinality, Phi at m before the move minus Phi at m after the move equals Phi at m-3 on this actual residual. The proof applies the original path-series recurrence to the configuration factorization and extracts coefficients after multiplication by the integer Catalan series. The six-vertex cardinality equation supplies all natural-subtraction bounds, including the case m equal to the full cardinality.
+
+The equality allows an arbitrary graph on R, including nonforests. Nonnegativity of the difference follows only when the actual induced residual is acyclic and every residual degree is at most two, by the finite-forest Catalan theorem. The statement includes empty tails when either parameter equals one, two empty tails when both equal one, empty R, original isolates, and arbitrary actual relabelings. It makes no global extremum or native-capacity assertion.
+
+## References
+
+- Truth anchor: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/TwoPathConcentration.actual_two_path_concentration`
+- Dependency: [D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/FiniteForestCatalan](FiniteForestCatalan.md)

+# Abstract finite noncyclic upper bounds
+
+## Abstract
+
+Signed covers bound the actual order of every finite noncyclic abelian group.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (The actual relation lattice).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper_dichotomy`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper_dichotomy` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* B. Bajnok and W. K. Beatty (2024). *On the Diameter of Undirected Cayley Graphs of Finite Abelian Groups*. URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04045v1>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For an arbitrary finite additive commutative group G in any universe, a noncyclicity proof and a signed cover by a,b of natural radius s ≥ 3 yield a natural c ≥ 2. Either |G| ≤ 2s², or c is odd, c divides 2s+1, and 2|G| ≤ (2s+1)²−c². No distinctness, regularity or product normal form is assumed. The coefficient homomorphism from Z² is onto because of the cover; its quotient by its actual kernel is additively equivalent to G, so its actual index is |G|. Mathlib supplies classical Smith diagonal bases and two nonzero coefficients, without any ordered invariant-factor assertion. Coprimality would make their ZMod product cyclic, contradicting the hypothesis. Their gcd is at least two. Expanding each kernel vector in the bottom basis proves both original coordinates divisible by that gcd; this step does not confuse Smith coordinates with the coordinates of a,b. The public lattice_upper_bound then reuses the existing square-compression and scaled-index proof.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (Prime 2s+1).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper_prime`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper_prime` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* B. Bajnok and W. K. Beatty (2024). *On the Diameter of Undirected Cayley Graphs of Finite Abelian Groups*. URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04045v1>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+When 2s+1 is prime, every nontrivial common divisor c in the high-index branch equals 2s+1. The high bound then forces twice the positive group order to be at most zero. Thus |G| ≤ 2s².
+
+**Theorem 1.3 (Composite 2s+1).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper_composite`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper_composite` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* B. Bajnok and W. K. Beatty (2024). *On the Diameter of Undirected Cayley Graphs of Finite Abelian Groups*. URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04045v1>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+When 2s+1 is composite and p is its least prime factor, the exact conclusion in natural arithmetic is 2|G| ≤ (2s+1)²−p². In the low branch p² ≤ 2s+1 makes the baseline sufficient. In the high branch p ≤ c and hence p² ≤ c² give the correction. The proof establishes nonnegativity before returning to natural subtraction.
+
+**Theorem 1.4 (The uniform upper endpoint).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattyFiniteUpper.finite_noncyclic_upper` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* B. Bajnok and W. K. Beatty (2024). *On the Diameter of Undirected Cayley Graphs of Finite Abelian Groups*. URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04045v1>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Every finite noncyclic abelian group with an arbitrary signed covering pair and s ≥ 3 has order at most 2s² when 2s+1 is prime, and satisfies twice the order at most (2s+1)² minus the least-prime-factor square otherwise. This is the abstract upper direction of Bajnok–Beatty arXiv:2406.04045v1 Conjecture 1.6. Matching lower constructions and assembly of the literal maximum are separate obligations. The Smith normal form machinery is classical; the formal transfer and estimate carry no claim of current literature novelty or publication priority.

+# The Bajnok–Beatty sharp maximum for radius at least three
+
+## Abstract
+
+The exact maximum order, including an actual finite noncyclic product attaining it.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (The natural maximum expression).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattySharpMaximum.MaximumOrder`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattySharpMaximum.MaximumOrder` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* B. Bajnok and W. K. Beatty (2024). *On the Diameter of Undirected Cayley Graphs of Finite Abelian Groups*. URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04045v1>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every natural s, MaximumOrder(s) is 2s² when 2s+1 is prime; otherwise it is 2s²+2s−(p²−1)/2, where p is the least prime factor of 2s+1. The expression is in natural numbers, with natural subtraction and division. The maximum theorem below applies only to s ≥ 3. In that range the composite arithmetic proves that neither subtraction truncates and that the correction (p²−1)/2 is an integer at least four.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (Universal upper bound and exact attainment).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattySharpMaximum.sharp_maximum`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/BajnokBeattySharpMaximum.sharp_maximum` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+

+  have he : (range 1).erase 0 = ∅ := by decide
+  have hc : closedComplement (SimpleGraph.hasse ℕ) (range 1) 0 = ∅ := by
+    simp [closedComplement]
+  have hh := partition_delete (SimpleGraph.hasse ℕ) (range 1) 0
+    (by simp) (fun _ => (-X : PowerSeries ℤ))
+  rw [he, hc, partition_empty] at hh
+  simpa [localPathSeries, partition_empty, sub_eq_add_neg] using hh

+private def localCatalanIntegerSeries : PowerSeries ℤ :=
+  PowerSeries.catalanSeries.map (Nat.castRingHom ℤ)

+private lemma localCoeffPartitionPhi {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
+    (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (V : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (hm : V.card ≤ m) :
+    PowerSeries.coeff m (partition G V (fun _ => -PowerSeries.X) * localCatalanIntegerSeries) =
+      phi G V m := by
+  open PowerSeries in
+    unfold partition phi
+    rw [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro S hS
+    have hsm : S.card ≤ m := (Finset.card_le_card
+      (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).1)).trans hm
+    have he : (-X : PowerSeries ℤ) ^ S.card = C ((-1 : ℤ) ^ S.card) * X ^ S.card := by
+      rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_pow]
+      simp
+    rw [Finset.prod_const, he, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_left hsm]
+    simp [localCatalanIntegerSeries]

+private lemma path_two : localPathSeries 2 = 1 - 2 * X := by
+  rw [show 2 = 0 + 2 by omega, localPathRec, localPathOne, localPathZero]
+  ring
+
+private lemma path_three : localPathSeries 3 = 1 - 3 * X + X ^ 2 := by
+  rw [show 3 = 1 + 2 by omega, localPathRec, path_two, localPathOne]
+  ring
+
+private lemma path_four : localPathSeries 4 = 1 - 4 * X + 3 * X ^ 2 := by
+  rw [show 4 = 2 + 2 by omega, localPathRec, path_three, path_two]
+  ring
+
+private lemma path_five : localPathSeries 5 = 1 - 5 * X + 6 * X ^ 2 - X ^ 3 := by
+  rw [localPathRec 3, path_four, path_three]
+  ring
+
+private lemma path_six : localPathSeries 6 = 1 - 6 * X + 10 * X ^ 2 - 4 * X ^ 3 := by
+  rw [localPathRec 4, path_five, path_four]
+  ring
+
+private lemma path_seven : localPathSeries 7 = 1 - 7 * X + 15 * X ^ 2 - 10 * X ^ 3 + X ^ 4 := by
+  rw [localPathRec 5, path_six, path_five]
+  ring

+private lemma two_path_series (n k : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
+    (localPathSeries n * localPathSeries k - localPathSeries (n + k - 1) * localPathSeries 1) =
+      X ^ 3 * localPathSeries (n - 3) * localPathSeries (k - 3) := by
+  induction hs : n + k using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing n k with
+  | h t ih =>
+      subst t
+      by_cases hn5 : 5 ≤ n
+      · have hn2 : 3 ≤ n - 2 := by omega
+        have hn1 : 3 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
+        have hsum2 : (n - 2) + k < n + k := by omega
+        have hsum1 : (n - 1) + k < n + k := by omega
+        have h₂ := ih ((n - 2) + k) hsum2 (n - 2) k hn2 hk rfl
+        have h₁ := ih ((n - 1) + k) hsum1 (n - 1) k hn1 hk rfl
+        have hna : n - 2 + 2 = n := by omega
+        rw [← hna, localPathRec (n - 2), hna,
+          show n + k - 1 = (n + k - 3) + 2 by omega,
+          localPathRec (n + k - 3), show n - 3 = (n - 5) + 2 by omega,
+          localPathRec (n - 5)] at ⊢
+        have hi₁ : n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 := by omega
+        have hi₂ : n + k - 3 + 1 = n - 1 + k - 1 := by omega
+        have hi₃ : n - 5 + 1 = n - 4 := by omega
+        have hi₄ : n - 1 - 3 = n - 4 := by omega
+        have hi₅ : n - 2 - 3 = n - 5 := by omega
+        have hiC : n + k - 3 = n - 2 + k - 1 := by omega
+        rw [hi₄] at h₁
+        rw [hi₅] at h₂
+        rw [hi₁, hi₂, hi₃, hiC] at ⊢
+        linear_combination h₁ - X * h₂
+      · have hn34 : n = 3 ∨ n = 4 := by omega
+        rcases hn34 with rfl | rfl
+        · by_cases hk5 : 5 ≤ k
+          · have hk2 : 3 ≤ k - 2 := by omega
+            have hk1 : 3 ≤ k - 1 := by omega
+            have hsum2 : 3 + (k - 2) < 3 + k := by omega
+            have hsum1 : 3 + (k - 1) < 3 + k := by omega
+            have h₂ := ih (3 + (k - 2)) hsum2 3 (k - 2) (by omega) hk2 rfl
+            have h₁ := ih (3 + (k - 1)) hsum1 3 (k - 1) (by omega) hk1 rfl
+            have hka : k - 2 + 2 = k := by omega
+            rw [← hka, localPathRec (k - 2), hka,
+              show 3 + k - 1 = k + 2 by omega,
+              localPathRec k, show k - 3 = (k - 5) + 2 by omega,
+              localPathRec (k - 5)] at ⊢
+            have hi₁ : k - 2 + 1 = k - 1 := by omega
+            have hi₂ : k - 1 - 3 = k - 5 + 1 := by omega
+            have hi₃ : k - 2 - 3 = k - 5 := by omega
+            have hiC₂ : 3 + (k - 2) - 1 = k := by omega
+            have hiC₁ : 3 + (k - 1) - 1 = k + 1 := by omega
+            rw [hi₃, hiC₂] at h₂
+            rw [hi₂, hiC₁] at h₁
+            rw [hi₁] at ⊢
+            linear_combination h₁ - X * h₂
+          · have hk34 : k = 3 ∨ k = 4 := by omega
+            rcases hk34 with rfl | rfl
+            · simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceSub]
+              rw [path_three, path_five, localPathOne, localPathZero]
+              ring_nf
+            · simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceSub]
+              rw [path_three, path_four, localPathOne, path_six, localPathZero]
+              ring_nf
+        · by_cases hk5 : 5 ≤ k
+          · have hk2 : 3 ≤ k - 2 := by omega
+            have hk1 : 3 ≤ k - 1 := by omega
+            have hsum2 : 4 + (k - 2) < 4 + k := by omega
+            have hsum1 : 4 + (k - 1) < 4 + k := by omega
+            have h₂ := ih (4 + (k - 2)) hsum2 4 (k - 2) (by omega) hk2 rfl
+            have h₁ := ih (4 + (k - 1)) hsum1 4 (k - 1) (by omega) hk1 rfl
+            have hka : k - 2 + 2 = k := by omega
+            rw [← hka, localPathRec (k - 2), hka,
+              show 4 + k - 1 = (k + 1) + 2 by omega,
+              localPathRec (k + 1), show k - 3 = (k - 5) + 2 by omega,
+              localPathRec (k - 5)] at ⊢
+            have hi₁ : k - 2 + 1 = k - 1 := by omega
+            have hi₂ : k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 := by omega
+            have hi₃ : k - 1 - 3 = k - 5 + 1 := by omega
+            have hi₄ : k - 2 - 3 = k - 5 := by omega
+            have hiC₁ : 4 + (k - 1) - 1 = k + 2 := by omega
+            have hiC₂ : 4 + (k - 2) - 1 = k + 1 := by omega
+            rw [hi₄] at h₂
+            rw [hiC₂] at h₂
+            rw [hiC₁, hi₃] at h₁
+            rw [hi₁] at ⊢
+            rw [hi₂] at ⊢
+            linear_combination h₁ - X * h₂
+          · have hk34 : k = 3 ∨ k = 4 := by omega
+            rcases hk34 with rfl | rfl
+            · simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceSub]
+              rw [path_four, path_three, localPathOne, path_six, localPathZero]
+              ring_nf
+            · simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceSub]
+              rw [path_four, localPathOne, path_seven]
+              ring_nf
+
+/-- The exact series law behind the two-path concentration move.
+The factor `R` is arbitrary, so it may be the actual partition series of any
+untouched finite residual graph. -/
+private theorem two_path_series_concentration (p q : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
+    (R : PowerSeries ℤ) :
+    (localPathSeries (2 * p + 1) * localPathSeries (2 * q + 1) * R -
+      localPathSeries (2 * p + 2 * q + 1) * localPathSeries 1 * R) =
+      X ^ 3 * localPathSeries (2 * p - 2) * localPathSeries (2 * q - 2) * R := by
+  have h := two_path_series (2 * p + 1) (2 * q + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
+  have h' := congrArg (fun t : PowerSeries ℤ => t * R) h
+  have hp' : 2 * p + 1 - 3 = 2 * p - 2 := by omega
+  have hq' : 2 * q + 1 - 3 = 2 * q - 2 := by omega
+  have hL : 2 * p + 1 + (2 * q + 1) - 1 = 2 * p + 2 * q + 1 := by omega
+  rw [hp', hq'] at h'
+  rw [hL] at h'
+  convert h' using 1 <;> ring
+

+open SimpleGraph

+private lemma configurations_sum {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
+    (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
+    (V : Finset α) (W : Finset β) :
+    configurations (G ⊕g H) (V.disjSum W) =
+      ((configurations G V) ×ˢ (configurations H W)).image
+        (fun st => st.1.disjSum st.2) := by
+  classical
+  have hi (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) :
+      (G ⊕g H).IsIndepSet (S.disjSum T : Set (α ⊕ β)) ↔
+        G.IsIndepSet (S : Set α) ∧ H.IsIndepSet (T : Set β) := by
+    constructor
+    · intro h
+      constructor
+      · intro x hx y hy hn he
+        exact h (x := Sum.inl x) (y := Sum.inl y) (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
+          (by simpa using hn) (by simpa using he)
+      · intro x hx y hy hn he
+        exact h (x := Sum.inr x) (y := Sum.inr y) (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
+          (by simpa using hn) (by simpa using he)
+    · rintro ⟨hs, ht⟩ (x | x) hx (y | y) hy hn he
+      · exact hs (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
+          (by simpa using hn) he
+      · simpa using he
+      · simpa using he
+      · exact ht (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
+          (by simpa using hn) he
+  ext U
+  constructor
+  · intro hU
+    have hh := Finset.mem_filter.mp hU
+    have hs := Finset.subset_disjSum.mp (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hh.1)
+    have hind := (hi U.toLeft U.toRight).mp (by
+      simpa only [Finset.toLeft_disjSum_toRight] using hh.2)
+    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(U.toLeft, U.toRight),
+      Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hs.1, hind.1⟩,
+        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hs.2, hind.2⟩⟩,
+      Finset.toLeft_disjSum_toRight⟩
+  · rintro hU
+    obtain ⟨⟨S,T⟩, hST, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hU
+    obtain ⟨hS,hT⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hST
+    obtain ⟨hs, hiS⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hS
+    obtain ⟨ht, hiT⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hT
+    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr
+      (Finset.disjSum_mono (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hs) (Finset.mem_powerset.mp ht)),
+      (hi S T).mpr ⟨hiS,hiT⟩⟩
+
+private lemma partition_sum {α β K : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
+    [CommSemiring K] (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β)
+    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
+    (V : Finset α) (W : Finset β) (w : α ⊕ β → K) :
+    partition (G ⊕g H) (V.disjSum W) w =
+      partition G V (fun x => w (.inl x)) * partition H W (fun x => w (.inr x)) := by
+  classical
+  unfold partition
+  rw [configurations_sum]
+  rw [Finset.sum_image (by
+    intro x hx y hy he
+    exact Prod.ext (Finset.disjSum_inj.mp he).1 (Finset.disjSum_inj.mp he).2)]
+  simp only [Finset.prod_disjSum]
+  rw [Finset.sum_product]
+  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
+
+private lemma partition_subtype {α K : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [CommSemiring K]
+    (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (V : Finset α) (w : α → K) :
+    partition (G.induce (V : Set α)) univ (fun x => w x.val) = partition G V w := by
+  classical
+  unfold partition
+  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun S _ => S.image Subtype.val)
+  · intro S hS
+    have hh := Finset.mem_filter.mp hS
+    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
+    · intro x hx
+      obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
+      exact x.property
+    · intro x hx y hy hn he
+      obtain ⟨a,ha,hax⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
+      obtain ⟨b,hb,hby⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
+      subst x
+      subst y
+      exact hh.2 ha hb (fun h => hn (congrArg Subtype.val h)) he
+  · intro S hS T hT he
+    exact Finset.image_injective (Subtype.val_injective) he
+  · intro S hS
+    have hh := Finset.mem_filter.mp hS
+    let T : Finset (V : Set α) := S.attach.image
+      (fun x => (⟨x.val, (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hh.1) x.property⟩ : (V : Set α)))
+    refine ⟨T, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (Finset.subset_univ T), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
+    · intro x hx y hy hn he
+      obtain ⟨a,ha,hax⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
+      obtain ⟨b,hb,hby⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
+      exact hh.2 (by simpa [← hax] using a.property)
+        (by simpa [← hby] using b.property) (fun h => hn (Subtype.ext h)) he
+    · ext x
+      simp [T]
+      exact fun hx => (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hh.1) hx
+  · intro S hS
+    exact (Finset.prod_image (fun x _ y _ h => Subtype.ext h)).symm
+
+private lemma partition_path (n : ℕ) :
+    partition (pathGraph n) univ (fun _ => (-X : PowerSeries ℤ)) = localPathSeries n := by
+  classical
+  let e : Fin n ≃ (range n : Set ℕ) :=
+    { toFun := fun i => ⟨i.val, by simpa using i.isLt⟩
+      invFun := fun i => ⟨i.val, by simpa using i.property⟩
+      left_inv := by intro i; rfl
+      right_inv := by intro i; rfl }
+  have he : ∀ i j, ((SimpleGraph.hasse ℕ).induce (range n : Set ℕ)).Adj (e i) (e j) ↔
+      (pathGraph n).Adj i j := by
+    intro i j
+    change (SimpleGraph.hasse ℕ).Adj i.val j.val ↔ (pathGraph n).Adj i j
+    rw [localPathAdj, pathGraph_adj]
+  have hh := partition_relabel (pathGraph n) ((SimpleGraph.hasse ℕ).induce (range n : Set ℕ))
+    e he univ (fun _ => (-X : PowerSeries ℤ))
+  rw [Finset.image_univ_equiv] at hh
+  rw [partition_subtype (SimpleGraph.hasse ℕ) (range n) (fun _ => (-X : PowerSeries ℤ))] at hh
+  exact hh.symm
+

+private lemma partition_embedding {α β K : Type*} [Fintype α]
+    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [CommSemiring K]
+    (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel H.Adj]
+    (f : α ↪ β) (hf : ∀ x y, H.Adj (f x) (f y) ↔ G.Adj x y) (w : β → K) :
+    partition H (univ.image f) w = partition G univ (fun x => w (f x)) := by
+  classical
+  let V := univ.image f
+  let e : α ≃ (V : Set β) := Equiv.ofBijective
+    (fun x => ⟨f x, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, mem_univ x, rfl⟩⟩)
+    ⟨fun x y h => f.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h), by
+      intro y
+      obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp y.property
+      exact ⟨x, Subtype.ext he⟩⟩
+  have h := partition_relabel G (H.induce (V : Set β)) e
+    (fun x y => hf x y) univ (fun x => w x.val)
+  rw [Finset.image_univ_equiv, partition_subtype H V w] at h
+  exact h

+/-- Separate the last B vertex of the first path and concatenate its even
+prefix with the entire second path. -/
+def joinEquiv (p q : ℕ) :
+    Fin (2 * p + 1) ⊕ Fin (2 * q + 1) ≃
+      Fin (2 * p + (2 * q + 1)) ⊕ Fin 1 :=
+  (Equiv.sumCongr finSumFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl _)).trans
+    ((Equiv.sumAssoc _ _ _).trans
+      ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.sumComm _ _)).trans
+        ((Equiv.sumAssoc _ _ _).symm.trans
+          (Equiv.sumCongr finSumFinEquiv (Equiv.refl _)))))
+
+private lemma join_left (p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * p)) :
+    joinEquiv p q (.inl (i.castAdd 1)) =
+      .inl (i.castAdd (2 * q + 1)) := by
+  simp [joinEquiv]
+
+private lemma join_right (p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * q + 1)) :
+    joinEquiv p q (.inr i) = .inl (i.natAdd (2 * p)) := by
+  simp [joinEquiv]
+
+private lemma join_isolate (p q : ℕ) :
+    joinEquiv p q (.inl (Fin.last (2 * p))) = .inr 0 := by
+  simp [joinEquiv]

+/-- A complete actual component witness; the residual is the given induced
+subgraph on `R`, and its labels are fixed by the coordinate map. -/
+structure ActualTwoPaths {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
+    (G : SimpleGraph α) (A B R : Finset α) (p q : ℕ) where
+  labels : α ≃ ((Fin (2 * p + 1) ⊕ Fin (2 * q + 1)) ⊕ (R : Set α))
+  rest : ∀ r : (R : Set α), labels r.val = .inr r
+  adjacency : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y ↔
+    (((pathGraph (2 * p + 1)) ⊕g (pathGraph (2 * q + 1))) ⊕g
+      (G.induce (R : Set α))).Adj (labels x) (labels y)
+  left_start : labels.symm (.inl (.inl 0)) ∈ B
+  right_start : labels.symm (.inl (.inr 0)) ∈ B
+
+namespace ActualTwoPaths
+variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
+  {G : SimpleGraph α} {A B R : Finset α} {p q : ℕ}
+
+private lemma path_colours (n : ℕ) (f : Fin (n + 1) → α)
+    (hf : ∀ i j, (pathGraph (n + 1)).Adj i j → G.Adj (f i) (f j))
+    (hA : G.IsIndepSet (A : Set α)) (hB : G.IsIndepSet (B : Set α))
+    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hcover : A ∪ B = univ) (hzero : f 0 ∈ B)
+    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : (f i ∈ A ↔ Odd i.val) ∧ (f i ∈ B ↔ Even i.val) := by
+  have cover (x : α) : x ∈ A ∨ x ∈ B := by simpa [← hcover] using mem_univ x
+  let beta : (pathGraph (n + 1)).Coloring Bool := Coloring.mk
+    (fun i => decide (f i ∈ B)) (by
+      intro i j hij
+      have hadj := hf i j hij
+      have hne : f i ≠ f j := hadj.ne
+      by_cases hi : f i ∈ B
+      · have hj : f j ∉ B := fun hj => hB hi hj hne hadj
+        simp [hi, hj]
+      · have hiA := (cover (f i)).resolve_right hi
+        have hj : f j ∈ B := by
+          by_contra hj
+          exact hA hiA ((cover (f j)).resolve_right hj) hne hadj
+        simp [hi, hj])
+  have hbzero : beta 0 = true := by exact decide_eq_true hzero
+  have hpzero : (pathGraph.bicoloring (n + 1)) 0 = true := by rfl
+  obtain ⟨walk⟩ := (connected_pathGraph_add_one n) 0 i
+  have hb := beta.even_length_iff_congr walk
+  have ht := (pathGraph.bicoloring (n + 1)).even_length_iff_congr walk
+  have hbi : f i ∈ B ↔ Even i.val := by
+    have hsame : (beta i : Prop) ↔ ((pathGraph.bicoloring (n + 1)) i : Prop) := by
+      simpa only [hbzero, hpzero, Bool.true_eq, true_iff] using hb.symm.trans ht
+    change (decide (f i ∈ B) = true) ↔ (decide (i.val % 2 = 0) = true) at hsame
+    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, ← Nat.even_iff] using hsame
+  refine ⟨?_, hbi⟩
+  have hab : f i ∈ A ↔ f i ∉ B := by
+    constructor
+    · intro hi hj; exact disjoint_left.mp hAB hi hj
+    · intro hi; exact (cover (f i)).resolve_right hi
+  rw [hab, hbi, Nat.not_even_iff_odd]
+
+private lemma left_colours (w : ActualTwoPaths G A B R p q)
+    (hA : G.IsIndepSet (A : Set α)) (hB : G.IsIndepSet (B : Set α))
+    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hc : A ∪ B = univ) (i : Fin (2 * p + 1)) :
+    (w.labels.symm (.inl (.inl i)) ∈ A ↔ Odd i.val) ∧
+    (w.labels.symm (.inl (.inl i)) ∈ B ↔ Even i.val) := by
+  apply path_colours (2 * p) (fun j => w.labels.symm (.inl (.inl j)))
+    (fun j k hjk => (w.adjacency _ _).mpr (by simpa using hjk)) hA hB hAB hc w.left_start
+
+private lemma right_colours (w : ActualTwoPaths G A B R p q)
+    (hA : G.IsIndepSet (A : Set α)) (hB : G.IsIndepSet (B : Set α))
+    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hc : A ∪ B = univ) (i : Fin (2 * q + 1)) :
+    (w.labels.symm (.inl (.inr i)) ∈ A ↔ Odd i.val) ∧
+    (w.labels.symm (.inl (.inr i)) ∈ B ↔ Even i.val) := by
+  apply path_colours (2 * q) (fun j => w.labels.symm (.inl (.inr j)))
+    (fun j k hjk => (w.adjacency _ _).mpr (by simpa using hjk)) hA hB hAB hc w.right_start
+

+    ac (A + B) C = ac A C + ac B C := by unfold ac; noncomm_ring

+    ac A (B + C) = ac A B + ac A C := by unfold ac; noncomm_ring

+structure Family (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] where

+  exact commutes_function (actualBasis F B) totalCount (d0 F p)
+    (by simpa only [M_eq_number F B] using M_commutes_d0 F p) (fun n => if n = 0 then 0 else (n : ℂ)⁻¹)
+
+private theorem invM_commutes_R (p : Charge D) : invM F B * R F p = R F p * invM F B := by
+  exact commutes_function (actualBasis F B) totalCount (R F p)
+    (by simpa only [M_eq_number F B] using M_commutes_R F p) (fun n => if n = 0 then 0 else (n : ℂ)⁻¹)
+
+theorem homotopy_contraction (p : Charge D) (hp : F.pPlus p ≠ 0) :
+    d0 F p * h F B p + h F B p * d0 F p = 1 - P0 F B := by
+  calc
+    _ = (d0 F p * R F p + R F p * d0 F p) * invM F B := by
+      simp only [h, add_mul, mul_assoc, invM_commutes_d0 F B p]
+    _ = M F * invM F B := by rw [original_contraction F p hp]
+    _ = _ := (spectral_projection_inverse F B).1
+
+theorem homotopy_square (p : Charge D) : h F B p * h F B p = 0 := by
+  calc
+    _ = R F p * (invM F B * R F p) * invM F B := by rw [h]; noncomm_ring
+    _ = (R F p * R F p) * (invM F B * invM F B) := by
+      rw [invM_commutes_R F B p]; noncomm_ring
+    _ = 0 := by rw [R_square, zero_mul]
+
+def NoLongitudinal (m : Exponents t) : Prop := ∀ r, m (plus t,r) = 0 ∧ m (minus t,r) = 0
+
+private theorem longitudinalCount_zero_iff (m : Exponents t) :
+    longitudinalCount m = 0 ↔ NoLongitudinal m := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · intro hm r
+    have hd : localDegree m r = 0 := by
+      by_cases hr : r ∈ frequencies m
+      · have hl := Finset.single_le_sum (fun s (_ : s ∈ frequencies m) =>
+          Nat.zero_le (localDegree m s)) hr
+        change localDegree m r ≤ longitudinalCount m at hl
+        omega
+      · exact localDegree_zero_outside m r hr
+    exact Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.mp hd
+  · intro hm
+    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+    intro r hr
+    simp [localDegree, (hm r).1, (hm r).2]
+
+private theorem totalCount_zero_iff (i : StateIndex D t) :
+    totalCount i = 0 ↔ NoLongitudinal i.1.2 ∧ (i.2 = {1} ∨ i.2 = {1,3}) := by
+  simp only [totalCount, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, longitudinalCount_zero_iff, GC.count_zero_iff]
+
+def transverseVariable (x : Fin t × ℕ) : Variables t := (transverse t x.1,x.2)
+
+private theorem transverseVariable_injective : Function.Injective (transverseVariable (t := t)) := by
+  intro x y h
+  rcases x with ⟨i,r⟩
+  rcases y with ⟨j,s⟩
+  simpa [transverseVariable, transverse] using h
+
+private theorem noLongitudinal_mapDomain (d : (Fin t × ℕ) →₀ ℕ) :
+    NoLongitudinal (d.mapDomain transverseVariable) := by
+  intro r
+  constructor
+  · apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
+    rintro ⟨⟨j,s⟩,h⟩
+    simp [transverseVariable, transverse, plus] at h
+  · apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
+    rintro ⟨⟨j,s⟩,h⟩
+    simp [transverseVariable, transverse, minus] at h
+
+private theorem noLongitudinal_support (m : Exponents t) (hm : NoLongitudinal m) :
+    (m.support : Set (Variables t)) ⊆ Set.range transverseVariable := by
+  intro x hx
+  rcases x with ⟨l,r⟩
+  rcases l with u | (u | j)
+  · cases u
+    exact False.elim ((Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx) (hm r).1)
+  · cases u
+    exact False.elim ((Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx) (hm r).2)
+  · exact ⟨(j,r),rfl⟩
+
+/-- Surjectivity onto precisely the polynomials with no longitudinal variables is constructed. -/
+private theorem transverse_monomial_preimage (m : Exponents t) (hm : NoLongitudinal m) :
+    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ,
+      rename transverseVariable Q = monomial m 1 := by
+  refine ⟨monomial (m.comapDomain transverseVariable transverseVariable_injective.injOn) 1, ?_⟩
+  rw [rename_monomial, Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain transverseVariable
+    transverseVariable_injective m (noLongitudinal_support m hm)]
+
+/-- Actual polynomial in the supplied basis of the actual K, inside the original oscillator. -/
+def transverseOriginal : MvPolynomial (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] Oscillator D :=
+  (F.coordinateEquiv B).symm.toAlgHom.comp (rename transverseVariable)
+
+def ghostB0 : Module.End ℂ (State D) := tp 1 (b 0)
+def chargeMatter (p : Charge D) : Module.End ℂ (Carrier D) :=
+  (Finsupp.lsingle p).comp (Finsupp.lapply p)
+def chargeProject (p : Charge D) : Module.End ℂ (State D) := tp (chargeMatter p) 1
+
+private theorem ghost_sector (p : Charge D) (Q : PolynomialCoordinates (Label t))
+    (w : Fock) (G : Module.End ℂ Fock) :
+    tp (1 : Module.End ℂ (Carrier D)) G (sector F B p Q w) = sector F B p Q (G w) := by
+  simp [sector]
+
+private theorem chargeProject_basis (p : Charge D) (i : StateIndex D t) :
+    chargeProject p (actualBasis F B i) =
+      (if i.1.1 = p then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • actualBasis F B i := by
+  rcases i with ⟨⟨q,m⟩,S⟩
+  simp only [actualBasis_apply]
+  by_cases h : q = p
+  · subst q
+    simp [chargeProject, chargeMatter, sector]
+  · simp [chargeProject, chargeMatter, sector, h, Ne.symm h]
+
+private theorem chargeProject_diagonal (p : Charge D) : chargeProject (D := D) p =
+    diagonal (actualBasis F B) (fun i => if i.1.1 = p then 1 else 0) := by
+  apply (actualBasis F B).ext
+  intro i
+  rw [chargeProject_basis, diagonal_basis]
+
+private theorem fixed_charge_coefficients (p : Charge D) (v : State D) :
+    chargeProject p v = v ↔ ∀ i : StateIndex D t, i.1.1 ≠ p → (actualBasis F B).repr v i = 0 := by
+  rw [chargeProject_diagonal F B]
+  constructor
+  · intro h i hi
+    have hh := congrArg (fun w => (actualBasis F B).repr w i) h
+    simpa [diagonal_coefficient, hi] using hh.symm
+  · intro h
+    apply (actualBasis F B).repr.injective
+    ext i
+    by_cases hi : i.1.1 = p
+    · simp [diagonal_coefficient, hi]
+    · simp [diagonal_coefficient, hi, h i hi]
+
+/-- The literal original b0 kernel is detected, without imposing a physical mass shell. -/
+private theorem b0_coefficients (v : State D) : ghostB0 v = 0 ↔
+    ∀ i : StateIndex D t, 3 ∈ i.2 → (actualBasis F B).repr v i = 0 := by
+  classical
+  let J : Module.End ℂ (State D) := tp 1 (create 3 * annihilate 3)
+  have hJ : J = diagonal (actualBasis F B) (fun i => if 3 ∈ i.2 then 1 else 0) := by
+    apply (actualBasis F B).ext
+    rintro ⟨⟨p,m⟩,S⟩
+    rw [diagonal_basis, actualBasis_apply]
+    change tp 1 (create 3 * annihilate 3) (sector F B p (monomial m 1) (ket S)) = _
+    rw [ghost_sector,
+      D5.S3.Quantum.Fermionic.BcGhostQuartetCount.create_annihilate_ket]
+    by_cases h3 : 3 ∈ S <;> simp [h3, sector]
+  have hfac : J = tp 1 (create 3) * ghostB0 := by
+    simpa [J, ghostB0, GC.b_zero, tp] using
+      TensorProduct.map_mul (1 : Module.End ℂ (Carrier D)) 1 (create 3) (annihilate 3)
+  constructor
+  · intro hb i hi
+    have hz : J v = 0 := by rw [hfac, Module.End.mul_apply, hb, map_zero]
+    have hh := congrArg (fun w => (actualBasis F B).repr w i) hz
+    rw [hJ, diagonal_coefficient] at hh
+    simpa [hi] using hh
+  · intro hv
+    rw [← basis_expansion F B v]
+    simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
+    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+    intro i hi
+    by_cases h3 : 3 ∈ i.2
+    · rw [hv i h3, zero_smul]
+    · rcases i with ⟨⟨p,m⟩,S⟩
+      rw [actualBasis_apply]
+      simp [ghostB0, ghost_sector, GC.b_zero, annihilate_ket, h3, sector]
+
+def groundMap (p : Charge D) : MvPolynomial (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] State D :=
+  ((TensorProduct.mk ℂ (Carrier D) Fock).flip
+    D5.S3.Quantum.Fermionic.BcGhostQuartetCount.c1vac).comp
+      ((Finsupp.lsingle p).comp (transverseOriginal F B).toLinearMap)
+
+private theorem groundMap_apply (p : Charge D) (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ) :
+    groundMap F B p Q = Finsupp.single p (transverseOriginal F B Q) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
+      D5.S3.Quantum.Fermionic.BcGhostQuartetCount.c1vac := rfl
+
+private theorem groundMap_sector (p : Charge D) (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ) :
+    groundMap F B p Q = sector F B p (rename transverseVariable Q) (ket {1}) := by
+  rw [groundMap_apply, D5.S3.Quantum.Fermionic.BcGhostQuartetCount.c1vac_eq]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem groundMap_monomial (p : Charge D) (d : (Fin t × ℕ) →₀ ℕ) :
+    groundMap F B p (monomial d 1) = actualBasis F B
+      (⟨p,d.mapDomain transverseVariable⟩,{1}) := by
+  rw [groundMap_sector, rename_monomial, actualBasis_apply]
+
+private theorem groundMap_identities (p : Charge D) :
+    (M F).comp (groundMap F B p) = 0 ∧ ghostB0.comp (groundMap F B p) = 0 ∧
+    (chargeProject p).comp (groundMap F B p) = groundMap F B p := by
+  have hq (d : (Fin t × ℕ) →₀ ℕ) : totalCount (D := D)
+      (⟨p,d.mapDomain transverseVariable⟩,{1}) = 0 := by
+    apply (totalCount_zero_iff _).mpr
+    exact ⟨noLongitudinal_mapDomain d, Or.inl rfl⟩
+  repeat' constructor
+  all_goals
+    apply (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ).ext
+    intro d
+    simp only [MvPolynomial.coe_basisMonomials, LinearMap.comp_apply, groundMap_monomial]
+  · rw [M_basis, hq]; simp
+  · rw [actualBasis_apply]
+    simp [ghostB0, ghost_sector, GC.b_zero, annihilate_ket, sector]
+  · rw [chargeProject_basis]
+    simp only [if_pos rfl, if_true, one_smul]
+
+/-- Full ghost zero count has two states, before b0 is imposed. -/
+private theorem full_zero_count_coefficients (v : State D) : M F v = 0 ↔
+    ∀ i ∈ ((actualBasis F B).repr v).support,
+      NoLongitudinal i.1.2 ∧ (i.2 = {1} ∨ i.2 = {1,3}) := by
+  rw [M_eq_number F B, kernel_number_iff]
+  constructor
+  · intro h i hi
+    apply (totalCount_zero_iff i).mp
+    by_contra hn
+    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (h i hn)
+  · intro h i hn
+    by_contra hc
+    exact hn ((totalCount_zero_iff i).mpr (h i (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hc)))
+
+/-- Exact fixed-integral-charge, literal-kerb0 ground; Q is an arbitrary polynomial
+in the actual supplied transverse basis. This is not a claim about the physical
+relative BRST complex, which additionally needs totalL0 and the actual remainder. -/
+theorem literal_relative_ground (p : Charge D) (v : State D) :
+    (M F v = 0 ∧ ghostB0 v = 0 ∧ chargeProject p v = v) ↔
+      ∃ Q : MvPolynomial (Fin t × ℕ) ℂ,
+        v = Finsupp.single p (transverseOriginal F B Q) ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
+          D5.S3.Quantum.Fermionic.BcGhostQuartetCount.c1vac := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨hm,hb,hp⟩
+    have hground : v ∈ LinearMap.range (groundMap F B p) := by
+      rw [← basis_expansion F B v]
+      apply Submodule.sum_mem
+      intro i hi
+      have hm' := (full_zero_count_coefficients F B v).mp hm i hi
+      have hb' := (b0_coefficients F B v).mp hb
+      have hp' := (fixed_charge_coefficients F B p v).mp hp
+      have hcharge : i.1.1 = p := by
+        by_contra hn
+        exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hp' i hn)
+      have hket : i.2 = {1} := by
+        rcases hm'.2 with h | h
+        · exact h
+        · exact False.elim ((Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hb' i (by simp [h])))
+      obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := transverse_monomial_preimage i.1.2 hm'.1
+      apply Submodule.smul_mem
+      refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
+      rw [groundMap_sector, hQ]
+      rcases i with ⟨⟨q,m⟩,S⟩
+      dsimp at hcharge hket
+      subst q
+      subst S
+      exact (actualBasis_apply F B p m {1}).symm
+    obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := hground
+    exact ⟨Q, hQ.symm.trans (groundMap_apply F B p Q)⟩
+  · rintro ⟨Q,rfl⟩
+    change M F (groundMap F B p Q) = 0 ∧ ghostB0 (groundMap F B p Q) = 0 ∧
+      chargeProject p (groundMap F B p Q) = groundMap F B p Q
+    exact ⟨LinearMap.congr_fun (groundMap_identities F B p).1 Q,
+      LinearMap.congr_fun (groundMap_identities F B p).2.1 Q,
+      LinearMap.congr_fun (groundMap_identities F B p).2.2 Q⟩
+
+private theorem b0_dm (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : ac (ghostB0 (D := D)) (dm F n) = 0 := by
+  have hc : b 0 * c (-n) + c (-n) * b 0 = 0 := by
+    simpa [hn] using ghost_mixed_car 0 (-n)
+  rw [ghostB0, dm, tp_ac]
+  simp only [one_mul, mul_one, sub_self, tp, TensorProduct.map_zero_left, TensorProduct.map_zero_right, hc, add_zero]
+
+private theorem b0_rr (n : ℤ) : ac (ghostB0 (D := D)) (rr F n) = 0 := by
+  rw [ghostB0, rr, tp_ac]
+  simp only [one_mul, mul_one, sub_self, tp, TensorProduct.map_zero_left, TensorProduct.map_zero_right, ghost_b_car, add_zero]
+
+private theorem b0_unscaledD : ac (ghostB0 (D := D)) (unscaledD F) = 0 := by
+  apply Family.total_ac_fixed
+  intro r
+  simp only [dFamily, dTerm, ac_add_right, b0_dm F _ (by omega : (r : ℤ)+1 ≠ 0), b0_dm F _ (by omega : -((r : ℤ)+1) ≠ 0), add_zero]
+
+private theorem b0_unscaledR : ac (ghostB0 (D := D)) (unscaledR F) = 0 := by
+  apply Family.total_ac_fixed
+  intro r
+  simp [rFamily, rTerm, ac_smul_right, ac_add_right, b0_rr]
+
+theorem b0_d0 (p : Charge D) : ac (ghostB0 (D := D)) (d0 F p) = 0 := by
+  rw [d0, ac_smul_right, b0_unscaledD, smul_zero]
+private theorem b0_R (p : Charge D) : ac (ghostB0 (D := D)) (R F p) = 0 := by
+  rw [R, ac_smul_right, b0_unscaledR, smul_zero]
+
+private theorem odd_even_commutes {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
+    (T A C : Module.End ℂ V) (hA : ac T A = 0) (hC : ac T C = 0) :
+    T * ac A C = ac A C * T := by
+  have hTA : T*A = -(A*T) := eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr hA
+  have hTC : T*C = -(C*T) := eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr hC
+  calc
+    _ = (T*A)*C + (T*C)*A := by unfold ac; noncomm_ring
+    _ = -(A*T)*C + -(C*T)*A := by rw [hTA,hTC]
+    _ = -(A*(T*C)) - C*(T*A) := by noncomm_ring
+    _ = _ := by rw [hTC,hTA]; unfold ac; noncomm_ring
+
+private theorem M_commutes_b0 : M F * ghostB0 = ghostB0 * M F := by
+  simp only [← unscaled_contraction F]
+  exact (odd_even_commutes ghostB0 (unscaledD F) (unscaledR F)
+    (b0_unscaledD F) (b0_unscaledR F)).symm
+
+private theorem invM_commutes_b0 : invM F B * ghostB0 = ghostB0 * invM F B := by
+  exact commutes_function (actualBasis F B) totalCount ghostB0
+    (by simpa only [M_eq_number F B] using M_commutes_b0 F) (fun n => if n = 0 then 0 else (n : ℂ)⁻¹)
+theorem P0_commutes_b0 : P0 F B * ghostB0 = ghostB0 * P0 F B := by
+  exact commutes_function (actualBasis F B) totalCount ghostB0
+    (by simpa only [M_eq_number F B] using M_commutes_b0 F) (fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
+
+private theorem chargeMatter_a (p : Charge D) (u : E D) (n : ℤ) :
+    chargeMatter p * a u n = a u n * chargeMatter p := by
+  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
+  intro q P
+  by_cases hq : q=p
+  · subst q
+    simp [Module.End.mul_apply, chargeMatter, a_single]
+  · simp [Module.End.mul_apply, chargeMatter, a_single, hq, Ne.symm hq]
+
+private theorem chargeProject_current (p : Charge D) (u : E D) (n : ℤ) (G : Module.End ℂ Fock) :
+    chargeProject p * tp (a u n) G = tp (a u n) G * chargeProject p := by
+  simp only [chargeProject, tp, ← TensorProduct.map_mul, one_mul, mul_one, chargeMatter_a]
+
+theorem chargeProject_d0 (p q : Charge D) :
+    chargeProject p * d0 F q = d0 F q * chargeProject p := by
+  have hu : chargeProject p * unscaledD F = unscaledD F * chargeProject p := by
+    apply Family.total_commutes_fixed
+    intro r
+    simp [dFamily, dTerm, dm, mul_add, add_mul, chargeProject_current]
+  simp only [d0, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, hu]
+
+theorem chargeProject_R (p q : Charge D) :
+    chargeProject p * R F q = R F q * chargeProject p := by
+  have hu : chargeProject p * unscaledR F = unscaledR F * chargeProject p := by
+    apply Family.total_commutes_fixed
+    intro r
+    simp [rFamily, rTerm, rr, mul_add, add_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
+      Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, chargeProject_current]
+  simp only [R, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, hu]
+
+private theorem spectral_remaining_identities : P0 F B * M F = 0 ∧
+    P0 F B * invM F B = 0 ∧ invM F B * P0 F B = 0 := by
+  rw [M_eq_number F B]
+  repeat' constructor
+  all_goals
+    apply (actualBasis F B).ext
+    intro i
+    by_cases hi : totalCount i=0
+    · simp [P0, invM, number, inverseNumber, projectZero, Module.End.mul_apply, hi]
+    · simp [P0, invM, number, inverseNumber, projectZero, Module.End.mul_apply, hi]
+
+private theorem P0_basis (i : StateIndex D t) : P0 F B (actualBasis F B i) =
+    (if totalCount i=0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • actualBasis F B i := by
+  simp [P0, projectZero]
+
+private theorem P0_commutes_R (p : Charge D) : P0 F B * R F p = R F p * P0 F B := by
+  exact commutes_function (actualBasis F B) totalCount (R F p)
+    (by simpa only [M_eq_number F B] using M_commutes_R F p) (fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
+
+theorem h_mul_P0 (p : Charge D) : h F B p * P0 F B = 0 := by
+  rw [h, mul_assoc, (spectral_remaining_identities F B).2.2, mul_zero]
+
+theorem P0_mul_h (p : Charge D) : P0 F B * h F B p = 0 := by
+  rw [h, ← mul_assoc, P0_commutes_R, mul_assoc,
+    (spectral_remaining_identities F B).2.1, mul_zero]
+
+private theorem dTerm_zero_count (r : ℕ) (i : StateIndex D t)
+    (hi : totalCount i = 0) : dTerm F r (actualBasis F B i) = 0 := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨hm,hS⟩ := (totalCount_zero_iff i).mp hi
+  rcases i with ⟨⟨p,m⟩,S⟩
+  have hd : pderiv (plus t,r) (monomial m (1 : ℂ)) = 0 := by
+    simp [pderiv_monomial, (hm r).1]
+  have hc : c ((r : ℤ)+1) (ket S) = 0 := by
+    rcases hS with rfl | rfl
+    all_goals
+      by_cases hr : r = 0
+      · subst r
+        simp [GC.c_positive_one]
+      · have hr2 : 2 ≤ r+1 := by omega
+        have he1 : 2*(r+1-2) ≠ 1 := by omega
+        have he3 : 2*(r+1-2) ≠ 3 := by omega
+        have hh := GC.c_positive_ge_two (r+1) hr2
+        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hh
+        rw [hh]
+        simp only [annihilate_ket, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, he1, he3, or_self, if_false]
+  rw [actualBasis_apply, grouped_coordinate_d, hd, hc]
+  simp [sector]
+
+theorem d0_mul_P0 (p : Charge D) : d0 F p * P0 F B = 0 := by
+  apply (actualBasis F B).ext
+  intro i
+  change d0 F p (P0 F B (actualBasis F B i)) = 0
+  rw [P0_basis]
+  by_cases hi : totalCount i = 0
+  · simp only [hi, if_pos rfl, if_true, one_smul]
+    change F.pPlus p • (dFamily F).total (actualBasis F B i) = 0
+    rw [(dFamily F).total_eq_sum _ (modeBound F (actualBasis F B i)) le_rfl]
+    simp only [dFamily, dTerm_zero_count F B _ i hi, Finset.sum_const_zero, smul_zero]
+  · simp only [if_neg hi, zero_smul, map_zero]
+
+theorem P0_mul_d0 (p : Charge D) : P0 F B * d0 F p = 0 := by
+  have hc : P0 F B * d0 F p = d0 F p * P0 F B :=
+    commutes_function (actualBasis F B) totalCount (d0 F p)
+      (by simpa only [M_eq_number F B] using M_commutes_d0 F p)
+      (fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
+  exact hc.trans (d0_mul_P0 F B p)
+
+/-- The actual inverse-count homotopy preserves the literal b0 kernel. -/

+    (w : List (Index D)) → ModeTuple D w → ℤ → Module.End ℂ (Oscillator D)

+  | i :: w, modes, e =>
+    if modes.1 < 0 then oscillatorJet D i modes.1 *
+      oscillatorFlat D a w modes.2 (e + 2*modes.1 + 2*i.2 + 3)

+/-- The existing pointwise tensor support bound also bounds the oscillator terms.

+        groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z) =
+      groundForm D hu t x * groundForm D hu y z := by
+  classical
+  have rank_eq : D.rank = groundRank D hu + groundRank D hu :=
+    (Classical.choose_spec

+  have central : groundRepresentation D hu (QuotientGroup.mk (⟨1, 0⟩ : Extension D)) =

+    have product : chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a * rankOne =

+      ext v
+      simp [rankOne, Module.End.mul_apply]
+    change (Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ *

+  simpa [coefficient, rankOne, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, map_smul,
+    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using expanded

+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) := by
+  classical
+  have complete := ground_completeness D hu
+    (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z) y
+    (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) t
+  trans ∑ b : ModTwoCharge D,
+    (Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ * quadraticSign D b *
+      groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b
+        (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z)) *
+      groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b
+        (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x))
+  · exact (mul_comm _ _).trans complete.symm
+  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight a) _ _
+  intro b
+  have haa : a+a = 0 := by funext i; exact CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero (a i)
+  have sign := sign_square (modTwoCocycle D b a)
+  change _ = (Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
+    quadraticSign D (a+(b+a)) *
+      groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (b+a) z) *
+      groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (b+a) x)
+  rw [show a+(b+a) = b by rw [add_comm b a, ← add_assoc, haa, zero_add] ]
+  change _ * _ * groundForm D hu y
+    ((chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b *
+      chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a) z) * groundForm D hu t
+    ((chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b *
+      chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a) x) = _
+  simp only [chargeOperator_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
+  calc
+    _ = (complexSign (modTwoCocycle D b a) * complexSign (modTwoCocycle D b a)) *
+        ((Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ * quadraticSign D b *
+          groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (b+a) z) *
+          groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (b+a) x)) := by ring
+    _ = _ := by rw [sign, one_mul]
+
+/-- G4: first channel into the common (y,z;x,t) channel, with the exact character. -/
+theorem ground_exchange_first (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (a : ModTwoCharge D) (x y z t : ActualGround D hu) :
+    groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+      groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z) =
+    ∑ b : ModTwoCharge D,
+      (Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ * quadraticSign D a * fourierSign D a b *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) := by
+  rw [ground_rechannel]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro b hb
+  rw [quadraticSign_add,
+    (ground_pairing_symmetric D hu (selectedGroundPairing D hu)).eq y
+      (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b z), ground_adjoint]
+  have hs := quadraticSign_square D b
+  calc
+    _ = (quadraticSign D b * quadraticSign D b) *
+        ((Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ * quadraticSign D a * fourierSign D a b *
+          groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+          groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x)) := by ring
+    _ = _ := by rw [hs, one_mul]
+
+/-- G5: second right channel into the SAME common ground channel. -/
+theorem ground_exchange_second (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (a : ModTwoCharge D) (x y z t : ActualGround D hu) :
+    groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+      groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y) =
+    ∑ b : ModTwoCharge D,
+      (Module.finrank ℂ (ActualGround D hu) : ℂ)⁻¹ * quadraticSign D (a+b) *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) := by
+  exact ground_rechannel D hu a x z y t
+
+/-- The oscillator part of the ACTUAL ordered homogeneous source functional.
+The exponent is 2s, not -2s-2. Both original L(1) powers and factorial cutoffs
+are retained literally. -/
+def oscillatorKernel (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (a : Charge D) (p P Q : Oscillator D) : ℂ :=
+  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (K-1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H-1),
+    let s : ℤ := k+1-(i : ℤ)-2*(H : ℤ)+(j : ℤ)
+    ((-1 : ℂ)^((H : ℤ)+s) / ((i.factorial : ℂ)*(j.factorial : ℂ))) *
+      wick D ((oscillatorLower D ^ i) Q)
+        (oscillatorCorrected D hu a (2*s) p ((oscillatorLower D ^ j) P))
+
+private theorem kernel_single_tmul (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (a : Charge D) (p P Q : Oscillator D)
+    (x y : ActualGround D hu) :
+    kernel D hu H K k (P ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) (Q ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) (Finsupp.single a p) =
+      chargeScalar D a * oscillatorKernel D hu H K k a p P Q *
+        groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (reduceCharge D a) x) := by
+  classical
+  simp only [kernel, oscillatorKernel, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
+    smul_eq_mul, CorrectedInversion.K_R, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, T, lower_power_tmul, corrected_tmul,
+    map_smul, actualForm_tmul, groundAction_reduction, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro i hi
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro j hj
+  ring
+
+private theorem chargeScalar_neg (D : LatticeData) (a : Charge D) :
+    chargeScalar D (-a) = chargeScalar D a := by
+  simp only [chargeScalar, chargeNorm, bilinear_neg_neg]
+
+/-- O4. Every signed original energy-fiber element is present. The dual
+polynomial is the EXISTING -(k+1)^(-1) G^(-1) substitution divided by all
+occupation factorials. The TWO charged scalar factors are explicit. The
+theta reflection is inside one, and only one, half-average. -/
+def cosetKernel (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K : ℕ) (k t : ℤ) (P Q R S : Oscillator D) (a : ModTwoCharge D) : ℂ :=
+  (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ᶠ b : EnergyFiber D ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)-k-1),
+    if reduceCharge D b.val.1 = a then
+      chargeScalar D b.val.1 * chargeScalar D (-b.val.1) *
+        (oscillatorKernel D hu H K k b.val.1 (MvPolynomial.monomial b.val.2 1) P Q +
+          oscillatorKernel D hu H K k (-b.val.1)
+            (sigma D (MvPolynomial.monomial b.val.2 1)) P Q) *
+        wick D S (oscillatorCorrected D hu (-b.val.1) (-2*t-2)
+          (dualOscillatorMonomial D b.val.2) R)
+    else 0
+
+/-- O5 on the unchanged actual tensor inputs. Ground vectors are unrestricted;
+P,Q may be any original polynomials that realize the stated actual homogeneous
+inputs. R and the detector S have no homogeneity or parity restriction.
+This uses the original source inverse and its full-fiber half-average. -/
+theorem fourM_factorization (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (h24 : D.rank = 24)
+    (H K : ℕ) (k t : ℤ)
+    (u v : HalfFock.LatticeHalfFockParityField.paritySpace D hu (-1))
+    (P Q R S : Oscillator D) (x y z d : ActualGround D hu)
+    (huP : u.val = P ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) (hvQ : v.val = Q ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y)
+    (huH : actualTensorL0 D hu u.val = (H : ℂ) • u.val)
+    (hvK : actualTensorL0 D hu v.val = (K : ℂ) • v.val) :
+    fourMScalar D hu hD k t u v (R ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z) (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d) =
+      ∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, cosetKernel D hu H K k t P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z) := by
+  classical
+  let h : ℤ := (H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)-k-1
+  letI := energyFiber_finite D hD h
+  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (EnergyFiber D h)
+  have contracted := (fourM_contraction D hu hD h24 H K k t u v
+    (R ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z) (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d) huH hvK).1
+  rw [fourMScalar, originalI_homogeneous D hu hD h24 H K k u v huH hvK]
+  change actualForm D hu (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d)
+    ((correctedField D hu ((sourceGradePairingEquiv D hu hD h).symm
+      (normalizedCoefficient D hu k u v h)).val).coeff (-2*t-2) (R ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z)) = _
+  rw [contracted]
+  let term : EnergyFiber D h → ℂ := fun b =>
+    chargeScalar D b.val.1 * chargeScalar D (-b.val.1) *
+      (oscillatorKernel D hu H K k b.val.1 (MvPolynomial.monomial b.val.2 1) P Q +
+        oscillatorKernel D hu H K k (-b.val.1)
+          (sigma D (MvPolynomial.monomial b.val.2 1)) P Q) *
+      wick D S (oscillatorCorrected D hu (-b.val.1) (-2*t-2)
+        (dualOscillatorMonomial D b.val.2) R)
+  trans (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ b : EnergyFiber D h,
+    term b *
+      groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (reduceCharge D b.val.1) x) *
+      groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) (reduceCharge D b.val.1) z)
+  · congr 1
+    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro b hb
+    rw [huP, hvQ, carrierBasis_apply]
+    change (kernel D hu H K k (P ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) (Q ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y)
+        (Finsupp.single b.val.1 (MvPolynomial.monomial b.val.2 1)) +
+      kernel D hu H K k (P ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) (Q ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y)
+        (thetaLinear D (Finsupp.single b.val.1 (MvPolynomial.monomial b.val.2 1)))) * _ = _
+    rw [theta_single, kernel_single_tmul, kernel_single_tmul]
+    simp only [dualCarrierBasis, corrected_tmul, map_smul, actualForm_tmul,
+      chargeScalar_neg, groundAction_reduction,
+      map_neg]
+    have negRed : -reduceCharge D b.val.1 = reduceCharge D b.val.1 := by
+      funext i; exact CharTwo.neg_eq _
+    rw [negRed]
+    dsimp only [term]
+    rw [chargeScalar_neg]
+    ring
+  · simp only [cosetKernel, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, ← mul_assoc,
+      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro b hb
+    simp only [mul_assoc, ite_mul, zero_mul]
+    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (reduceCharge D b.val.1)]
+    · simp [term, mul_assoc]
+    · intro a ha hne
+      simp [Ne.symm hne]
+    · simp
+
+/-- The common-channel four-linear tensors are independent on the ORIGINAL
+selected ground. This isolates a coefficient using the existing operator basis;
+it does not assert crossing or add a ground-algebra premise. -/
+theorem ground_tensor_independent (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (c : ModTwoCharge D → ℂ)
+    (vanishes : ∀ x y z t : ActualGround D hu,
+      ∑ b : ModTwoCharge D, c b *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) = 0) :
+    ∀ b, c b = 0 := by
+  classical
+  have rank_eq : D.rank = groundRank D hu + groundRank D hu :=
+    (Classical.choose_spec
+      (Classical.choose_spec (actual_twisted_ground_representation D hu))).1
+  have central : groundRepresentation D hu (QuotientGroup.mk (⟨1, 0⟩ : Extension D)) =
+      -(1 : Module.End ℂ (ActualGround D hu)) := by
+    simpa [complexSign] using selected_central D hu 1
+  obtain ⟨algebra⟩ := actual_operator_algebra D hu (groundRank D hu) rank_eq
+    (groundRepresentation D hu) central
+  have operatorZero (x t : ActualGround D hu) :
+      ∑ b : ModTwoCharge D,
+        (c b * groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x)) •
+          chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b = 0 := by
+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro y
+    apply (selectedGroundPairing D hu).nondegenerate.2
+    intro z
+    simpa [LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
+      smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using vanishes x y z t
+  intro b
+  have coordinate (x t : ActualGround D hu) :
+      c b * groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) = 0 := by
+    have h := congrArg (traceCoefficient D (groundRepresentation D hu) b) (operatorZero x t)
+    simpa [map_sum, map_smul, coefficient_operator D hu (groundRepresentation D hu) central] using h
+  by_contra hc
+  have zeroOperator : chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b = 0 := by
+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro x
+    apply (selectedGroundPairing D hu).nondegenerate.2
+    intro t
+    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (coordinate x t)).resolve_left hc
+  exact algebra.basis.ne_zero b ((algebra.basis_apply b).trans zeroOperator)
+
+/-- The common output weight is H+K+L-m-n-r-2. These are literal finite
+coefficient sums, with all integer modes and both transported right phases. -/
+def channelA (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K : ℕ) (m n r : ℤ) (P Q R S : Oscillator D) (a : ModTwoCharge D) : ℂ :=
+  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)-r).toNat,
+    Ring.choose (m : ℂ) j *
+      cosetKernel D hu H K (r+(j : ℤ)) (m+n-(j : ℤ)) P Q R S a
+
+def channelB (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K L : ℕ) (m n r : ℤ) (P Q R S : Oscillator D) (a : ModTwoCharge D) : ℂ :=
+  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((K : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-n).toNat,
+    ∑ ell ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-m-n-r-3).toNat,
+      Ring.choose (r : ℂ) j * (-1 : ℂ)^(m+r+(ell : ℤ)+1) *
+        (ell.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ *
+          cosetKernel D hu K L (n+(j : ℤ)) (m+r-(j : ℤ)+(ell : ℤ))
+            Q R P ((oscillatorLower D ^ ell) S) a
+
+def channelD (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K L : ℕ) (m n r : ℤ) (P Q R S : Oscillator D) (a : ModTwoCharge D) : ℂ :=
+  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-m).toNat,
+    ∑ ell ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-m-n-r-3).toNat,
+      Ring.choose (r : ℂ) j * (-1 : ℂ)^(n+(ell : ℤ)+1) *
+        (ell.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ *
+          cosetKernel D hu H L (m+(j : ℤ)) (n+r-(j : ℤ)+(ell : ℤ))
+            P R Q ((oscillatorLower D ^ ell) S) a
+
+/-- K is an EXPLICIT charge-coset polynomial identity from cosetKernel.
+It is not defined by a Jacobi expression, and it is not proved in this file. -/
+def identityK (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (H K L : ℕ) (m n r : ℤ) (P Q R S : Oscillator D) : Prop :=
+  ∀ b : ModTwoCharge D,
+    (∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, quadraticSign D a * fourierSign D a b *
+      channelA D hu H K m n r P Q R S a) =
+    (2 : ℂ)^12 * channelB D hu H K L m n r P Q R S b -
+      ∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, quadraticSign D (a+b) *
+        channelD D hu H K L m n r P Q R S a
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
+/-- The actual original law on homogeneous tensor inputs is equivalent to the
+EXPLICIT charge-coset kernel law, tested against all oscillator/ground tensor
+detectors. TensorProduct.induction_on recovers every original detector. This
+consumes S and O5 and supplies their operator-to-polynomial connection.
+OriginalFourMReduction extends the INPUTS from these tensors to all states. -/
+theorem original_jacobi_tensor_kernel (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (h24 : D.rank = 24)
+    (H K L : ℕ) (m n r : ℤ) (u v w : paritySpace D hu (-1))
+    (P Q R : Oscillator D) (x y z : ActualGround D hu)
+    (huP : u.val = P ⊗ₜ[ℂ] x) (hvQ : v.val = Q ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) (hwR : w.val = R ⊗ₜ[ℂ] z)
+    (huH : actualTensorL0 D hu u.val = (H : ℂ) • u.val)
+    (hvK : actualTensorL0 D hu v.val = (K : ℂ) • v.val)
+    (hwL : actualTensorL0 D hu w.val = (L : ℂ) • w.val) :
+    originalJacobi D hu hD m n r u v w ↔
+    ∀ (S : Oscillator D) (d : ActualGround D hu),
+      (∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, channelA D hu H K m n r P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z)) =
+      (∑ b : ModTwoCharge D, channelB D hu H K L m n r P Q R S b *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x)) -
+      (∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, channelD D hu H K L m n r P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y)) := by
+  classical
+  let iterate (d : ActualTensor D hu) : ℂ :=
+    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)-r).toNat,
+      Ring.choose (m : ℂ) j * fourMScalar D hu hD (r+(j : ℤ)) (m+n-(j : ℤ)) u v w.val d
+  let first (d : ActualTensor D hu) : ℂ :=
+    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((K : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-n).toNat,
+      ∑ ell ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-m-n-r-3).toNat,
+        Ring.choose (r : ℂ) j * (-1 : ℂ)^(m+r+(ell : ℤ)+1) * (ell.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ *
+          fourMScalar D hu hD (n+(j : ℤ)) (m+r-(j : ℤ)+(ell : ℤ)) v w u.val
+            ((tensorL D (ActualGround D hu) (HalfFockSpectralFiberSource.actualInverse D) 1 ^ ell) d)
+  let second (d : ActualTensor D hu) : ℂ :=
+    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-m).toNat,
+      ∑ ell ∈ Finset.range ((H : ℤ)+(K : ℤ)+(L : ℤ)-m-n-r-3).toNat,
+        Ring.choose (r : ℂ) j * (-1 : ℂ)^(n+(ell : ℤ)+1) * (ell.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ *
+          fourMScalar D hu hD (m+(j : ℤ)) (n+r-(j : ℤ)+(ell : ℤ)) u w v.val
+            ((tensorL D (ActualGround D hu) (HalfFockSpectralFiberSource.actualInverse D) 1 ^ ell) d)
+  have leftExpansion (S : Oscillator D) (d : ActualGround D hu) :
+      iterate (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d) =
+      ∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, channelA D hu H K m n r P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z) := by
+    dsimp only [iterate]
+    simp only [channelA, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro j hj
+    rw [hwR, fourM_factorization D hu hD h24 H K (r+(j : ℤ)) (m+n-(j : ℤ))
+      u v P Q R S x y z d huP hvQ huH hvK]
+    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro a ha
+    ring
+  have firstExpansion (S : Oscillator D) (d : ActualGround D hu) :
+      first (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d) =
+      ∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, channelB D hu H K L m n r P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) := by
+    dsimp only [first]
+    simp only [channelB, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
+    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro j hj
+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro ell hell
+    rw [huP, lower_power_tmul,
+      fourM_factorization D hu hD h24 K L (n+(j : ℤ)) (m+r-(j : ℤ)+(ell : ℤ))
+        v w Q R P ((oscillatorLower D ^ ell) S) y z x d hvQ hwR hvK hwL]
+    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro a ha
+    ring
+  have secondExpansion (S : Oscillator D) (d : ActualGround D hu) :
+      second (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d) =
+      ∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, channelD D hu H K L m n r P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu d (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y) := by
+    dsimp only [second]
+    simp only [channelD, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
+    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro j hj
+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro ell hell
+    rw [hvQ, lower_power_tmul,
+      fourM_factorization D hu hD h24 H L (m+(j : ℤ)) (n+r-(j : ℤ)+(ell : ℤ))
+        u w P R Q ((oscillatorLower D ^ ell) S) x z y d huP hwR huH hwL]
+    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro a ha
+    ring
+  rw [original_jacobi_scalar_finite D hu hD h24 H K L m n r u v w huH hvK hwL]
+  change (∀ d, iterate d = first d-second d) ↔ _
+  constructor
+  · intro original S d
+    have h := original (S ⊗ₜ[ℂ] d)
+    rwa [leftExpansion, firstExpansion, secondExpansion] at h
+  · intro polynomial d

+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z)) =
+      (∑ b : ModTwoCharge D, channelB D hu H K L m n r P Q R S b *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x)) -
+      (∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, channelD D hu H K L m n r P Q R S a *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y))) ↔

+  let A := channelA D hu H K m n r P Q R S
+  let B := channelB D hu H K L m n r P Q R S
+  let F := channelD D hu H K L m n r P Q R S

+  have size_ne : size ≠ 0 := by dsimp [size]; norm_num

+    (∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, quadraticSign D a * fourierSign D a b * A a) -

+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z)) =

+          groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) := by

+    field_simp

+      size * (∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, F a *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y)) =
+      ∑ b : ModTwoCharge D,

+          groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x) := by

+          groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *

+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro a ha

+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro b hb
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro a ha
+    dsimp only [size]
+    field_simp
+  have expansion (x y z t : ActualGround D hu) :
+      size * ((∑ a : ModTwoCharge D, A a *
+        groundForm D hu y (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a x) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a z)) -
+      (∑ b : ModTwoCharge D, B b *
+        groundForm D hu z (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b y) *
+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) b x)) +

+        groundForm D hu t (chargeOperator D (groundRepresentation D hu) a y))) =

+    have zero := (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left size_ne
+    change _ = _ - _
+    linear_combination zero

+end D5.S3.VertexAlgebra.TwistedGround.OriginalFourMChargeCoset

+/-- The GLOBAL original source-valued coefficient. DirectSum.toModule evaluates

+def originalI (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (k : ℤ) :
+    HalfFock.LatticeHalfFockParityField.paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ]
+      HalfFock.LatticeHalfFockParityField.paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ] FixedCarrier D :=
+  let inverse : FixedRestrictedDual D →ₗ[ℂ] FixedCarrier D :=
+    DirectSum.toModule ℂ ℤ (FixedCarrier D) (fun h =>
+      (Submodule.inclusion (show fixedGrade D h ≤ fixedSpace D from inf_le_right)).comp

+/-- Checking a trilinear law on compatible homogeneous polynomial tensors

+theorem input_trilinear_ext (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (h24 : D.rank = 24) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
+    (F : paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ] paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ]

+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro j hj

+  have ej := actual_input_basis_energy D hu h24 v j
+  have ek := actual_input_basis_energy D hu h24 w k

+  have qj := basis_compatible D hu v j
+  have qk := basis_compatible D hu w k

+    apply Subtype.ext
+    exact actual_basis_apply D hu i.val.1 i.val.2
+  have bj : actualInputBasis D hu v j = tensorInput D hu
+      (MvPolynomial.monomial j.val.1 1) qj.1 (Pi.single j.val.2 1) := by
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    exact actual_basis_apply D hu j.val.1 j.val.2

+      (MvPolynomial.monomial k.val.1 1) qk.1 (Pi.single k.val.2 1) := by
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    exact actual_basis_apply D hu k.val.1 k.val.2
+  rw [bi] at ei
+  rw [bj] at ej
+  rw [bk] at ek
+  rw [bi, bj, bk, hF _ _ _ _ _ _ qi qj qk _ _ _ ei ej ek, smul_zero]
+
+end D5.S3.VertexAlgebra.TwistedGround.OriginalFourMInputs

+
+private def jacobiTriples (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (m n r : ℤ) :
+    paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ] paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ]
+      paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ]
+        (ℕ → (paritySpace D hu (-1)) × (paritySpace D hu (-1)) × (paritySpace D hu (-1))) where
+  toFun a := {
+    toFun u := {
+      toFun v := fun j => (jacobiLeftTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j,
+        jacobiFirstTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j, jacobiSecondTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j)
+      map_add' v w := by
+        funext j
+        simp only [jacobiLeftTerm, jacobiFirstTerm, jacobiSecondTerm, map_add,
+          LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+      map_smul' z v := by
+        funext j
+        simp only [jacobiLeftTerm, jacobiFirstTerm, jacobiSecondTerm, map_smul,
+          LinearMap.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, smul_smul, Prod.smul_mk, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+        apply Prod.ext
+        · module
+        · apply Prod.ext <;> module }
+    map_add' u w := by
+      apply LinearMap.ext
+      intro v
+      funext j
+      simp only [jacobiLeftTerm, jacobiFirstTerm, jacobiSecondTerm, map_add,
+        LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+    map_smul' z u := by
+      apply LinearMap.ext
+      intro v
+      funext j
+      simp only [jacobiLeftTerm, jacobiFirstTerm, jacobiSecondTerm, map_smul,
+        LinearMap.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, smul_smul, Prod.smul_mk, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+      apply Prod.ext
+      · module
+      · apply Prod.ext <;> module }
+  map_add' a b := by
+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro u
+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro v
+    funext j
+    simp only [jacobiLeftTerm, jacobiFirstTerm, jacobiSecondTerm, map_add,
+      LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+  map_smul' z a := by

+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro v
+    funext j
+    simp only [jacobiLeftTerm, jacobiFirstTerm, jacobiSecondTerm, map_smul,
+      LinearMap.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, smul_smul, Prod.smul_mk, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]

+private theorem jacobi_triples_finite (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (m n r : ℤ) (a : paritySpace D hu (-1)) (u v : paritySpace D hu (-1)) :
+    Function.HasFiniteSupport (jacobiTriples D hu hD m n r a u v) := by
+  have hl := original_jacobi_left_finite D hu hD m n r a u v
+  have hf := original_jacobi_first_finite D hu hD m n r a u v
+  have hs := original_jacobi_second_finite D hu hD m n r a u v
+  change (Function.support (fun j => (jacobiLeftTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j,
+    jacobiFirstTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j, jacobiSecondTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j))).Finite
+  rw [Function.support_prodMk, Function.support_prodMk]
+  exact hl.union (hf.union hs)
+
+private def jacobiBalance (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det) :
+    ((paritySpace D hu (-1)) × (paritySpace D hu (-1)) × (paritySpace D hu (-1))) →ₗ[ℂ]
+      paritySpace D hu (-1) where
+  toFun x := x.1-x.2.1+x.2.2
+  map_add' x y := by dsimp; abel
+  map_smul' z x := by simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_sub, smul_add, RingHom.id_apply]
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
+private def jacobiResidual (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (m n r : ℤ) :
+    paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ] paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ]
+      paritySpace D hu (-1) →ₗ[ℂ] paritySpace D hu (-1) where
+  toFun a := {
+    toFun u := {
+      toFun v := jacobiBalance D hu (∑ᶠ j, jacobiTriples D hu hD m n r a u v j)
+      map_add' v w := by
+        simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+        rw [finsum_add_distrib (jacobi_triples_finite D hu hD m n r a u v)
+          (jacobi_triples_finite D hu hD m n r a u w), map_add]
+      map_smul' z v := by

+    map_add' u w := by

+      rw [finsum_add_distrib (jacobi_triples_finite D hu hD m n r a u v)
+        (jacobi_triples_finite D hu hD m n r a w v), map_add]
+    map_smul' z u := by
+      apply LinearMap.ext
+      intro v
+      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]

+  map_add' a b := by

+    intro u
+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro v
+    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+    rw [finsum_add_distrib (jacobi_triples_finite D hu hD m n r a u v)

+    intro u
+    apply LinearMap.ext
+    intro v
+    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
+    rw [← smul_finsum, map_smul]

+private theorem jacobi_residual_expansion (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (m n r : ℤ) (a : paritySpace D hu (-1)) (u v : paritySpace D hu (-1)) :
+    jacobiResidual D hu hD m n r a u v =
+      (∑ᶠ j, jacobiLeftTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j) -
+      (∑ᶠ j, jacobiFirstTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j) +
+      (∑ᶠ j, jacobiSecondTerm D hu hD m n r a u v j) := by
+  let F := jacobiTriples D hu hD m n r a u v
+  have finite := jacobi_triples_finite D hu hD m n r a u v
+  have fst := map_finsum (LinearMap.fst ℂ (paritySpace D hu (-1))
+    (paritySpace D hu (-1) × paritySpace D hu (-1))) finite
+  have snd := map_finsum (LinearMap.snd ℂ (paritySpace D hu (-1))
+    (paritySpace D hu (-1) × paritySpace D hu (-1))) finite
+  have finiteSnd : Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun j => (F j).2) := finite.snd
+  have sf := map_finsum (LinearMap.fst ℂ (paritySpace D hu (-1)) (paritySpace D hu (-1))) finiteSnd
+  have ss := map_finsum (LinearMap.snd ℂ (paritySpace D hu (-1)) (paritySpace D hu (-1))) finiteSnd
+  change (∑ᶠ j, F j).1-(∑ᶠ j, F j).2.1+(∑ᶠ j, F j).2.2 = _
+  change (∑ᶠ j, F j).1 = ∑ᶠ j, (F j).1 at fst
+  change (∑ᶠ j, F j).2 = ∑ᶠ j, (F j).2 at snd
+  change (∑ᶠ j, (F j).2).1 = ∑ᶠ j, (F j).2.1 at sf
+  change (∑ᶠ j, (F j).2).2 = ∑ᶠ j, (F j).2.2 at ss
+  rw [fst, snd, sf, ss]
+  rfl
+
+
+private theorem jacobi_residual_zero_iff (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (m n r : ℤ) (u v w : paritySpace D hu (-1)) :
+    jacobiResidual D hu hD m n r u v w = 0 ↔ originalJacobi D hu hD m n r u v w := by
+  rw [jacobi_residual_expansion, originalJacobi]
+  rw [show (∑ᶠ j, jacobiLeftTerm D hu hD m n r u v w j) -
+      (∑ᶠ j, jacobiFirstTerm D hu hD m n r u v w j) +
+      (∑ᶠ j, jacobiSecondTerm D hu hD m n r u v w j) =
+      (∑ᶠ j, jacobiLeftTerm D hu hD m n r u v w j) -
+        ((∑ᶠ j, jacobiFirstTerm D hu hD m n r u v w j) -
+          (∑ᶠ j, jacobiSecondTerm D hu hD m n r u v w j)) by abel,
+    sub_eq_zero]

+/-- The detector polynomial is quantified before ground elimination. All four
+actual ground variables are unrestricted; no output-weight premise is added. -/
+theorem homogeneous_jacobi_iff_identityK (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (h24 : D.rank = 24)
+    (H K L : ℕ) (m n r : ℤ) (P Q R : Oscillator D)
+    (hP : CompatiblePolynomial D H P) (hQ : CompatiblePolynomial D K Q)
+    (hR : CompatiblePolynomial D L R) :
+    (∀ x y z : ActualGround D hu,
+      originalJacobi D hu hD m n r (tensorInput D hu P hP.1 x)
+        (tensorInput D hu Q hQ.1 y) (tensorInput D hu R hR.1 z)) ↔
+    ∀ S : Oscillator D, identityK D hu H K L m n r P Q R S := by
+  have tensors (x y z : ActualGround D hu) := original_jacobi_tensor_kernel D hu hD h24
+    H K L m n r (tensorInput D hu P hP.1 x) (tensorInput D hu Q hQ.1 y)
+    (tensorInput D hu R hR.1 z) P Q R x y z rfl rfl rfl
+    (tensor_input_energy D hu h24 H P hP x)
+    (tensor_input_energy D hu h24 K Q hQ y)
+    (tensor_input_energy D hu h24 L R hR z)
+  constructor
+  · intro jacobi S
+    apply (coset_ground_elimination D hu h24 H K L m n r P Q R S).mp
+    intro x y z t
+    exact (tensors x y z).mp (jacobi x y z) S t
+  · intro kernels x y z
+    apply (tensors x y z).mpr
+    intro S t
+    exact (coset_ground_elimination D hu h24 H K L m n r P Q R S).mpr
+      (kernels S) x y z t
+
+/-- All original M states and arbitrary signed integer modes on the vector
+Jacobi side, equivalent to the independent explicit EnergyFiber coset law on
+all compatible original homogeneous odd polynomials. This proves a reduction,
+not K itself, crossing, or a VOA completion. -/
+theorem original_jacobi_iff_identityK (D : LatticeData) (hu : IsUnit D.G.det)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ))) (h24 : D.rank = 24)
+    (m n r : ℤ) :
+    (∀ u v w : paritySpace D hu (-1), originalJacobi D hu hD m n r u v w) ↔
+    ∀ (H K L : ℕ) (P Q R : Oscillator D),
+      CompatiblePolynomial D H P → CompatiblePolynomial D K Q →
+      CompatiblePolynomial D L R →
+      ∀ S : Oscillator D, identityK D hu H K L m n r P Q R S := by
+  constructor
+  · intro allStates H K L P Q R hP hQ hR
+    apply (homogeneous_jacobi_iff_identityK D hu hD h24 H K L m n r P Q R hP hQ hR).mp
+    intro x y z
+    exact allStates _ _ _
+  · intro kernels
+    have zero : ∀ u v w, jacobiResidual D hu hD m n r u v w = 0 := by
+      apply input_trilinear_ext D hu h24 (jacobiResidual D hu hD m n r)
+      intro H K L P Q R hP hQ hR x y z _ _ _
+      apply (jacobi_residual_zero_iff D hu hD m n r _ _ _).mpr
+      exact (homogeneous_jacobi_iff_identityK D hu hD h24 H K L m n r P Q R hP hQ hR).mpr
+        (kernels H K L P Q R hP hQ hR) x y z
+    intro u v w
+    exact (jacobi_residual_zero_iff D hu hD m n r u v w).mp (zero u v w)
+
+end D5.S3.VertexAlgebra.TwistedGround.OriginalFourMChargeCoset
